theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Health Care (+1.03%) and Utilities (+0.10%) led the market today, while Industrials (-2.71%) and Materials (-1.51%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.35%, defensives +0.35%, and value/cyclicals -1.39% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.22%, Dow -0.66%, Nasdaq -0.22% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.31%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.47% to 15.08, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.92% to $4,132.10, crude oil was little changed at $89.07, and bitcoin slipped 0.09% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
